en: How to compare. Report the difference \(\eta_{\text{test}}-\eta_{\text{theory}}\) at every halt. A percentage difference is meaningful only where the theoretical ordinate is not small: at halt 2, where \(\eta_A = 0.2\), a gauge error of one division (0.02 per unit load) is already 10 %, and where the theoretical value is zero the percentage is undefined. Judge the agreement by the absolute difference and by the shape of the line.
ms: Cara membandingkan. Laporkan perbezaan \(\eta_{\text{test}}-\eta_{\text{theory}}\) pada setiap halt. Perbezaan peratusan hanya bermakna apabila ordinate teori tidak kecil: di halt 2, di mana \(\eta_A = 0.2\), error gauge satu division (0.02 per unit load) sudah 10 %, dan apabila nilai teori sifar, peratusan tidak tertakrif. Nilai persetujuan berdasarkan perbezaan mutlak dan bentuk garis.

en: The extreme of a load train occurs with one load on a vertex.
ms: Nilai ekstrem load train berlaku dengan satu load pada vertex.

en: The laboratory model is a cantilever bridge 1130 mm long: two anchor beams with cantilever arms and a suspended span on hinges at C and D. You will move a mass along it, read six dial gauges, and compare what you measure with the influence lines that statics predicts.
ms: Model makmal ini ialah cantilever bridge sepanjang 1130 mm: dua anchor beam dengan cantilever arm, dan suspended span yang ditumpu pada hinge di C dan D. Anda akan menggerakkan jisim di sepanjang jambatan, membaca enam dial gauge, dan membandingkan hasil ukuran dengan influence line yang diramal oleh statik.
